notes.title: Version 1.1 live
notes.notes:
This is the first big update of this game and adds a lot of features.

New Features:
-- Beautiful skill icons. Thanks to @Kellon! we now have really beautiful unique icons for each skill and upgrades, instead of the ugly "up" ones.
-- Player hit sound effect. Now when you are hit, there will be a sound effect.
-- Different enemies, Now there are tank enemies and fast enemies that could be spawned.
-- Damage mechanism changed.
-- Enemy speed cap. Now there is a cap of speed for the enemies. Their speed will stop growing after level 30 when they reached the highest speed a player can get.
-- Enemy damage limited. After level 15 the damage of enemies will grow half as fast,
-- Guide menu remade. Now there is a setting screen, a weapons screen and a page 2 for skills and upgrades.

New Weapons:
Gun - a ranged weapon to shoot enemies.

New Skill:
Rapid Fire - you fire rapidly creating a bullet storm

New Upgrades:
Rapid Fire Duration Up
Explosive Round - your bullet can explode
Bullet Explosion Radius/Damage Up - upgrades to explosive round
Bullet Size Up - bigger bullet
Bullet Speed Up - faster bullet
Bullet Range Up - shoot enemies farther away
Fire Rate Up - fire faster

Skill Rebalance:
-- Fire Ball damage reduced, but it is still powerful.
-- Sword Wind frequency reduced, just so the gun has some advantages.

Due to a big change of the damage mechanism, bugs could be encountered, please report them so I can fix them.
